note: Prior MT5_BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED was a false negative from host-local .env. Discovery must run inside the worker container via createConfiguredMt5Client (same path as R_10).

priorFalseNegative.cause: CLI early-gated on local .env MT5_BRIDGE_URL/SECRET; production worker gets URL from Compose/resolveMt5BridgeUrl and SECRET from container env_file

productionCommand: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T worker pnpm --filter @regimex/worker exec tsx scripts/discoverXauUsdMt5.ts
